# claude-profile

> Manage multiple Claude Code configuration profiles. Switch between work, personal, and project-specific setups with transparent profile resolution.

claude-profile is a free, open-source shell tool that wraps the `claude` CLI binary with a transparent function. It automatically sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` to your active profile directory before each invocation, so you never need to think about profiles during normal use. Like nvm for Node.js or pyenv for Python, but for Claude Code configuration.

Each profile is a complete, isolated Claude Code configuration directory containing settings.json, .credentials.json, MCP server configs, CLAUDE.md, plugins, and history.

## Documentation

- [Landing page](https://pegasusheavy.github.io/claude-code-profiles/): Features, install instructions, commands, and FAQ
- [README](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/README.md): Full documentation with quick start, commands, how it works, platform support, and manual install
- [Full LLM context](https://pegasusheavy.github.io/claude-code-profiles/llms-full.txt): Complete project documentation for LLM ingestion

## Install

- Linux / macOS / WSL / Fish: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/main/install.sh | sh` (the installer detects Fish and sources native adapters)
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/main/install.ps1 | iex`

## Commands

- `claude-profile`: Show current profile status
- `claude-profile create <name>`: Create a new profile
- `claude-profile list`: List all profiles
- `claude-profile default [name]`: Get or set the default profile
- `claude-profile use <name>`: Switch to a profile for the current shell session
- `claude-profile local [name]`: Show, set, or `--remove` this directory's `.claude-profile`
- `claude-profile auto [on|off|status]`: Control directory-local auto-switching
- `claude-profile which [name]`: Show the config directory path
- `claude-profile delete <name>`: Delete a profile (with confirmation)
- `claude-profile help`: Show help

## Antigravity and Codex

- `agent-profile copy antigravity hafez`: snapshot the current Antigravity CLI and GUI data
- `agent-profile copy antigravity default hafez`: copy the managed default profile
- `agent-profile default antigravity hafez`: set the Antigravity default
- `agent-profile use antigravity hafez`: select a profile for the current shell
- `agent-profile restart antigravity`: open a fresh GUI window using the selected profile
- `agent-profile copy codex work`: snapshot current Codex data
- `agent-profile default codex work`: set the Codex default

`agy`, `antigravity`, `antigravity-ide`, and `codex` wrappers launch with the
selected profile. Antigravity uses a child `HOME` for the CLI and
`--user-data-dir` for the GUI; Codex uses `CODEX_HOME`. OS keyring credentials
are not copied.

Fish is supported through native sourceable adapters. Source
`claude-profile.fish` and `agent-profile.fish` from
`~/.config/fish/config.fish`; do not source the POSIX `.sh` adapters from Fish.

## Source Code

- [claude-profile.sh](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/claude-profile.sh): POSIX shell implementation (bash, zsh)
- [claude-profile.fish](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/claude-profile.fish): native Fish implementation
- [claude-profile-init.ps1](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/claude-profile-init.ps1): PowerShell implementation
- [claude-profile.cmd](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/claude-profile.cmd): Windows cmd.exe batch implementation
- [agent-profile.sh](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/agent-profile.sh): Antigravity and Codex POSIX wrappers
- [agent-profile.fish](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/agent-profile.fish): Antigravity and Codex native Fish wrappers
- [agent-profile-init.ps1](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/agent-profile-init.ps1): Antigravity and Codex PowerShell wrappers
- [agent-profile.cmd](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/agent-profile.cmd): Antigravity and Codex cmd.exe manager
- [install.sh](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/install.sh): Unix installer
- [install.ps1](https://github.com/pegasusheavy/claude-code-profiles/blob/main/install.ps1): Windows installer
